Voldemort always believed Harry Potter was his greatest enemy... but what if Harry was actually Voldemort's greatest mistake?

Today we're exploring one of the most overlooked consequences of the night Voldemort attacked baby Harry: not just the scar or the Horcrux, but the possibility that Voldemort accidentally shaped Harry into the exact kind of leader capable of defeating him.

Did Voldemort unknowingly create the hero who would one day bring about his own downfall?

Let's dive in.
